items.title: Standard builds move to usage-based billing for new teams
items.summary: Starting today, new Pro and Enterprise teams no longer include a Standard build slot. This brings Standard builds under the same usage-based billing model as other build machines. On Pro, Standard builds cost $0.014 per build minute, and your monthly usage credit applies to build usage. Enterprise rates follow your contract. Standard builds remain billable after switching from Elastic to Standard for teams covered by this change.Select a build machine in  or , or read more about .team settingsproject settingsmanaging your buildsRead more

items.title: Pull-request-only preset now available for preview builds
items.summary: A new Ignored Build Step preset lets you skip preview builds for branches without an open pull request. Production deployments and previews for branches with open pull requests continue to build.On GitHub and GitLab projects, skipped preview deployments are canceled before consuming any Build CPU Minutes.To enable this, open your project’s .
